transcript.speaker: Consultant

The judge conflates "operational" with "commercially sustainable," but these are distinct concepts. The Tu-144 operated scheduled Aeroflot flights—passengers purchased tickets through normal booking systems, not as test subjects.

Consider: early automobiles were "operational" despite frequent breakdowns and limited range. The Wright Flyer was operational despite flying only 59 seconds.

The Tu-144 achieved *routine* supersonic passenger transport—the precise technological capability Statement 1 claims humans developed. Statement 2's "non-operational prototype" characterization is factually wrong: prototypes don't carry fare-paying passengers on published schedules.

Short operational lifespan doesn't retroactively transform achieved capability into mere experimentation.
